# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

**Best overall: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)**
- It has two USB-C ports at 140W (PD 3.1) and a 300W total output, enough to fast-charge two MacBook Pros at once. The 26,250mAh (99.75Wh) battery stays under the 100Wh airline limit.
- In Macworld's test it fully charged a 14-inch M2 MacBook Pro, with enough left to take it back to 25%.
- It recharges at up to 250W and has an app. It has no built-in cable, though a 240W USB-C cable is included per Engadget.
- Price: about $200-$230 ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html), [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)).

**Best with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**
- Its retractable USB-C cable delivers up to 140W. It also has two 140W ports and two 65W ports.
- It recharges at up to 280W, to 80% in about 30 minutes using two ports. Macworld expects roughly 70-75% of a 16-inch MacBook Pro's battery from one charge.
- It has no USB-A port.
- Price: about $190-$220 ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html), [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)).

**Best value: ReelCharge ReelPro (27K, 200W)**
- It costs about $120 and has a built-in cable rated at 140W. Its USB-C and USB-A ports are both 100W.
- It's a new brand, so it's a bit riskier, but it has a 3-year warranty. WIRED is still testing its long-term durability ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)).
- Macworld also picked the INIU Cougar P64 (140W) as a value option, but I don't have its price ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html)).

## What to check for your MacBook Pro
- **16-inch:** Get a PD 3.1 (140W) bank. All three picks above qualify. On models older than the M4, the full 140W requires Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable. Over USB-C or Thunderbolt they are limited to 100W ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/819438/best-macbook-usb-c-charger.html)).
- **14-inch:** About 96W or more is enough for fast charging, so a 100W bank like the ReelPro works well.
- **Flying:** Banks over 100Wh aren't allowed on commercial flights. All the picks above are just under that limit.
- **Capacity:** Expect roughly one full charge of a 14-inch Pro, or about 70-80% of a 16-inch.

I can't browse, so I can't confirm current prices or stock. The linked reviews have "View Deal" buttons to the retailers. My other picks are the Anker 737 (140W, 24,000mAh), a cheaper older option from a less authoritative source ([Laptopbee](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-power-banks-for-macbook-pro/)), and Anker's 25K Laptop Power Bank, Engadget's best overall ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/computing/accessories/best-laptop-power-bank-120040388.html)).

Which MacBook Pro do you have (14" or 16", and which chip)? And do you need it for flights? I can narrow it down from there.
